top_signals.title: Gold Slumps Below $3,500 an Ounce To Lowest in More Than a Year
top_signals.summary: Gold tumbled below $3,500 an ounce to its lowest point in more than a year, as a selloff in stocks continued and investors waited for a key inflation print that could shape expectations of further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
